beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Ladies and Gentlemen!
I'm Lake Ulysses
councilman Bob Baiter!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"It's my pleasure to announce
after nearly a decade,"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"boating and fishing
are once again permitted
throughout our beautiful
three-thousand acre jewel!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"City council has been carefully
monitoring toxicity levels."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"With recent rains
and cooler temperatures
we are pleased to report that"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"state regional water boards
have deemed Lake Ulysses
as {slow}acceptable.{/slow}"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"You know what that means!
Your family and friends are"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"legally allowed to return
to our blue pride and joy!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Families are advised
not to drink the water,"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"or allow your pets
to enter the lake."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Pregnant women are cautioned
to keep their skin covered
at all times."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "And {slow}most importantly{/slow} —"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"give your catch of the day
a good scrubbin' with
some fresh bottled water!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"{slow}NOW AVAILABLE
AT MY SHOP!{/slow}"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"From live bait
to the latest fishing gear!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "We've got you covered!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "And thanks to your city council, every family in Lake Ulysses now carries our lake right in their pocket!"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "That's the official water reading, live in your FEELZ app. The county sensors keep an eye on it, so you don't have to worry."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "We're lookin' out for you."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "See those little fellas? Those are {slow}our{/slow} fish. The good Lord gave us this lake, and the county gave us the numbers to prove we're takin' care of it."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "Low number, clear water, happy fish. Number climbs, water clouds up, fish get to lookin' poorly. Simple as Sunday school."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "Clean water comes from clean living, folks. Every little thing a person keeps to themselves ends up in that water somehow."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "A fib here, a fib there? That water remembers. Every one of 'em muddies it a little more."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "But an honest word? Clears it right back up. Little by little. That's how the Lord does His washin'."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Now, we don't judge here.{pause:600}
We just {slow}measure.{/slow}"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "And come the end of the season, we all go down to the water together. Pastor Gabriel will see what you've been bringin' in."

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text: "So keep 'em swimmin'! And if it ever goes a little green on ya — water filters, {slow}NOW AVAILABLE AT MY SHOP!{/slow}"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Whether you're local
or just passin' by —"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"{slow}Welcome back,
Lake Ulysses!{/slow}"

beats.speaker: BOB BAITER
beats.text:
"Now let's go enjoy
our watery playground!"
